$comment: Descriptive contract only - no tool validates this file. The enforcers are build/generate.mjs + build/lib.mjs (including repo/pinnedCommit requirements for git entries); schema and generator must change in the same PR (AGENTS.md §4).
title: dsh-nano-market catalog entry (one JSONL line)

kind.description: git = install from GitHub (commit-pinned); npm = registry; local = dev-only, never built

name.description: npm package name; MUST equal the installed source's manifest name (build enforces)

repo.description: canonical https GitHub repo URL (git source)

path.description: package directory inside the repo (ascii); absent = repo root

ref.description: human alias, tag preferred; build resolves it and checks it equals pinnedCommit

pinnedCommit.description: REQUIRED for git entries: first-resolved commit; tag moves fail the build until the pin is updated deliberately

icon.description: relative (icons/x.svg), absolute https URL, or inline data: (<=32KiB)

repository.description: {url, directory?} display only, never selects the install source
